name: Kakuriyo
source:
The protaganist, Nagao Shuu, lives an uneventful life as a student. But one day a member of the Mystery Club, which Shuu also belongs to, gets a request- “I want you to investigate my big brother, he’s been acting weird lately.”

Shuu and his friends start investigating immediately. Strange things start happening, and they gradually get involved in a more serious case.

What does fate want from Shuu?

Is there any connection between this case and the mysterious transfer student who appeared at the same time?

When the sky is stained blood red, the “Kakuryo” appears...

[Translation of synopsis from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=8800]Getchu.com[/url]]
translation:
主人公长尾修过着平静的学生生活。某天，修所属神秘社团的一名成员收到委托：“我想让你调查哥哥，他最近的行为很奇怪。”

修和朋友们立即展开调查。随着怪事接连发生，他们渐渐被卷入更加严重的案件。

命运究竟想从修身上夺走什么？

这起案件与同时出现的神秘转校生有什么联系？

当天空染成血红色时，“角陵”出现了……

[摘要译自[url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=8800]Getchu.com[/url]]
